name: TBG PolyExponential Sigma Adder
plain: Blends the incoming schedule with a mirrored polyexponential curve running from the schedule's first sigma down to 1e−4. The blend weight is 1.001 minus the multiplier, so the default 0 changes nothing, a value near 0 still leaves about 0.1% of the curve, and 1 is almost all curve. Because the mirrored curve ends at 1e−4, not 0, any blend leaves a tiny nonzero final sigma. The ramp length counts the trailing 0 of the input.
math:
Symbols: σ input of length N; m multiplier; ρ rigidity; L = ln σ₀ − ln 1e−4.
If m = 0: σ unchanged.
c_i = σ₀ + 1e−4 − exp((i/(N−1))^ρ·L + ln 1e−4).
w = 1.001 − m. σ'_i = w·σ_i + (1 − w)·c_i.
